OMG i didn't know how to select the video recording screen properly so 1.5 minutes of the footage is blank..

### 2026-10-08 – Hellooo,

**5.28h**

Hellooo,
Today i decided to finish up on my DIY arduboy. First of all, i made so many mistakes with the schematic 😔😬. SO i fixed it all up.
 I made one additional board which supports flash module instead of smd soldering the flash chip.
I added SMD 5050 RGB  LEDs. (one extra pin header to take green led lead from the cpu since pin is not exposed)
 The issues i faced was fixing the CS and DI, DO pins from the flash module. Hopefully the fixes i did today will work 😭.

I hope that i get selected. If i get selected i will buy hot air station and soldering iron from the project store ☺️
